kids: Only bring children who are confident bike riders, since this is a parade and not a race
Santa leads the ride on a penny-farthing and nobody should pass him
Young families can enter the young family trophy category on the registration form
Families with small children can loop the route just once
site: Check-in tent on the north side of the Cocoa Riverfront Park bandshell
Staging under the park rotunda from 5 to 6:15 PM
Photo booth and hot cocoa at the finish
about: Trophies by artist Lori Prell go to the best decorated individual, young family, adult group, best use of hot cocoa and best Cocoa Village business, and riders name the award they are going for on the registration form.
E-bikes are allowed as long as riders do not turn on pedal assist, and the village asks everyone to put their own and other people's safety first when decorating a bike with lights and garlands.
After the ride, hot cocoa comes from OSSORIO and Open Air runs the photo booth, with sax from Fred Cavese and Pete Spoth as DJ while the awards are handed out.
faq: What time does the bike parade start?
Check-in runs 5 to 6:15 PM and the parade starts at 6:30 PM on Friday, December 18, 2026, according to Historic Cocoa Village.
Do we have to register?
Yes. Each person in a group completes their own registration form, which the event page links.
How long is the route?
A little less than 2 miles, about 30 minutes, with two loops before returning to Cocoa Riverfront Park.
Can we bring food donations?
Yes. The Central Brevard Sharing Center sets up next to the check-in tent to collect canned food for its pantry.
Does the page list a price?
No. The village page does not print a fee, so check the registration form.

kids: One cookie tin per family is the village's recommendation
Kids carry the map and collect a signature at each shop
A grand prize drawing rewards a fully signed map
Let each child carry the signed map
Collect a signature from every participating business
site: Cookie tin pickup at the Myrt Tharpe Square gazebo
about: The crawl is one part of the Hot Cocoa Holidays series that Historic Cocoa Village runs from November 28 through December 23, which also includes a Small Business Saturday open house on November 28 and a holiday bike parade on December 18.
The village's series page lists National Cocoa Day as December 13, and the crawl falls the day before on Saturday, December 12.
The event page says pre-sale tins were still coming soon, and that tins are otherwise sold the day of the event for $15.
Historic Cocoa Village describes the whole Hot Cocoa Holidays series as community hosted events, small business gifts and a downtown dressed in twinkle lights.
The cookie tin is filled with hot cocoa themed goodies from the participating businesses, and a fully signed map earns an entry in the grand prize drawing.
faq: How much is a cookie tin?
$15, sold at Myrt Tharpe Square, 12 Stone St, between 12 and 3 PM on December 12, 2026.
How many tins does a family need?
The village recommends one tin per family.
How do we win the grand prize?
Have your map signed by every participating business, then enter the drawing.
Is it indoors or outdoors?
You walk between shops in the Village, so dress for the weather.
What time does the crawl end?
The event page lists noon to 4 PM.
Where do we start?
At the gazebo at Myrt Tharpe Square, 12 Stone St, where you pick up your tin and a map.
Do all shops take part?
Only participating businesses are on the map, so follow the map rather than walking into every shop.
What else is on in the Village that month?
The Hot Cocoa Holidays series also lists a holiday bazaar on December 5 and 6 and a holiday bike parade on December 18.

kids: Santa and the Grinch both visit
site: First Baptist Church Merritt Island, 140 Magnolia Ave
about: Visit Space Coast's listing calls it the third annual market and invites the whole family to kick off the holiday season in Merritt Island.
The tourism board links its Visit Website button to a Facebook event page, and its own listing carries the date, hours, address and phone number.
Shoppers can browse local vendors for gifts while kids do crafts and visit Santa and the Grinch.
faq: When is the Christmas Market on Magnolia?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 3 to 7 PM.
Where is it?
First Baptist Church Merritt Island, 140 Magnolia Ave, Merritt Island, FL 32952.
Is there a price?
The listing does not print one, so check with the organizer.
Who can we call?
The listing gives 407-924-7116.
Is Santa there?
Yes, the listing says there are visits with Santa and the Grinch.
